description: This file contains MLlib utilities for linear algebra in PySpark, including definitions and implementations of vectors and matrices (dense and sparse), their serialization, operations, and factory methods. It also includes type definitions and support for SciPy sparse matrices if available.

classes.name: VectorUDT
classes.description: SQL user-defined type (UDT) for Vector, handling serialization/deserialization of vector objects.

classes.name: MatrixUDT
classes.description: SQL user-defined type (UDT) for Matrix, handling serialization/deserialization of matrix objects.

classes.name: Vector
classes.description: Abstract base class for dense and sparse vectors.

classes.name: DenseVector
classes.description: Implementation of a dense vector backed by a NumPy array, supporting vector operations.

classes.name: SparseVector
classes.description: Implementation of a sparse vector with indices and values, supporting vector operations.

classes.name: DenseMatrix
classes.description: Implementation of a dense matrix stored in column-major order.

classes.name: SparseMatrix
classes.description: Implementation of a sparse matrix in CSC format.

methods.name: _convert_to_vector
methods.description: Converts various input types to a Vector object.

methods.name: _vector_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a vector or sparse matrix column.

methods.name: _format_float
methods.description: Formats a float to a string with specified decimal digits.

methods.name: _format_float_list
methods.description: Formats a list of floats to strings.

methods.name: _double_to_long_bits
methods.description: Converts a float to its IEEE 754 binary representation as an integer.

methods.name: Vectors.sparse
methods.description: Factory method to create a SparseVector from various input types.

methods.name: Vectors.dense
methods.description: Factory method to create a DenseVector from a list or array.

methods.name: Vectors.squared_distance
methods.description: Computes squared Euclidean distance between two vectors.

methods.name: Vectors.norm
methods.description: Calculates the norm of a vector.

methods.name: Matrices.dense
methods.description: Factory method to create a DenseMatrix.

methods.name: Matrices.sparse
methods.description: Factory method to create a SparseMatrix.
